svg.title: Animated three by three systolic array matrix multiplication
svg.desc: All nine elements of matrix A stream right by row and all nine elements of matrix B stream down by column. Each processing element performs three synchronized multiply-accumulate operations before its output element is marked ready.
svg.text: A rows stream right · B columns stream down · each PE keeps one C[i,j] accumulator

g.text: gold = one MAC · green = all three MACs complete

svg.text: One shared timeline keeps every repeated loop synchronized.
